#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs the project-local .NET SDK defined in global.json.
# The SDK is placed under <repo-root>/.dotnet so it never conflicts with
# machine-wide installs.  After running this script, either:
#   • source eng/activate.sh   (sets PATH for the current shell), or
#   • use .dotnet/dotnet directly.

set -euo pipefail

repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
install_dir="$repo_root/.dotnet"

# --- Parse SDK version from global.json -----------------------------------
if ! command -v python3 &>/dev/null && ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
  # Fallback: lightweight grep/sed extraction
  sdk_version=$(grep -oP '"version"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' "$repo_root/global.json" | head -1)
else
  if command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then
    sdk_version=$(python3 -c "
import json, pathlib
g = json.loads(pathlib.Path('$repo_root/global.json').read_text())
print(g['sdk']['version'])
")
  else
    sdk_version=$(node -e "
const g = require('$repo_root/global.json');
console.log(g.sdk.version);
")
  fi
fi

if [[ -z "${sdk_version:-}" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Could not read sdk.version from $repo_root/global.json" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "Installing .NET SDK $sdk_version to $install_dir ..."

# --- Download the official install script ----------------------------------
installer="$repo_root/eng/dotnet-install.sh"
curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o "$installer"
chmod +x "$installer"

# --- Run it ----------------------------------------------------------------
"$installer" \
  --version "$sdk_version" \
  --install-dir "$install_dir" \
  --no-path

echo ""
echo "Done.  SDK installed to $install_dir"
echo "Activate with:  source eng/activate.sh"

+# Installs the project-local .NET SDK defined in global.json.
+# The SDK is placed under <repo-root>/.dotnet so it never conflicts with
+# machine-wide installs.  After running this script, either:
+#   • source eng/activate.sh   (sets PATH for the current shell), or
+#   • use .dotnet/dotnet directly.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+install_dir="$repo_root/.dotnet"
+
+# --- Parse SDK version from global.json -----------------------------------
+if ! command -v python3 &>/dev/null && ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
+  # Fallback: lightweight grep/sed extraction
+  sdk_version=$(grep -oP '"version"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+' "$repo_root/global.json" | head -1)
+else
+  if command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then
+    sdk_version=$(python3 -c "
+import json, pathlib
+g = json.loads(pathlib.Path('$repo_root/global.json').read_text())
+print(g['sdk']['version'])
+")
+  else
+    sdk_version=$(node -e "
+const g = require('$repo_root/global.json');
+console.log(g.sdk.version);
+")
+  fi
+fi
+
+if [[ -z "${sdk_version:-}" ]]; then
+  echo "ERROR: Could not read sdk.version from $repo_root/global.json" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+echo "Installing .NET SDK $sdk_version to $install_dir ..."
+
+# --- Download the official install script ----------------------------------
+installer="$repo_root/eng/dotnet-install.sh"
+curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o "$installer"
+chmod +x "$installer"
+
+# --- Run it ----------------------------------------------------------------
+"$installer" \
+  --version "$sdk_version" \
+  --install-dir "$install_dir" \
+  --no-path
+
+echo ""
+echo "Done.  SDK installed to $install_dir"
+echo "Activate with:  source eng/activate.sh"
+

| `eng/activate.sh` | Sets `PATH`/`DOTNET_ROOT` for the current shell |
| `eng/activate.ps1` | Same, for PowerShell |
